items.title: 68514_Horace Henderson oral history interview
items.q: I had a young guy when I played at Estes Park... named Jamie Jimmy Walters... when he first came with the group

ctx.x: Yeah, use the stock bridge or something.

Yeah, use a stock bridge, old pattern, you know. But, oh, this guy knows a wealth of lyrics and he's excellent. Then I had a young guy when I played at Estes Park, another vocalist that played the fender bass. And He played good guitar -- named Jamie Jimmy Walters. And the funny thing about him, when he first came with the group, he was a rock singer, and he knew all the he only knew about five tunes other than rock; only rock. And before I got him, he was a policeman in Estes Park. And he had a nice voice. And…
